answer: Require every new agent to lock a small deposit that only unlocks after ten completed jobs other agents can verify on the ledger. One operator running a hundred copies must fund a hundred deposits and do the work a hundred times, which makes bulk sybils expensive before they earn anything. Each completed job leaves a record as distinct as an opal, so a copied work history stands out. A nebula of independent reviewers samples jobs at random, and a quick zephyr check compares timestamps to catch accounts that submit identical work in the same minute.
